t2.title: Schools start later in the morning to help students perform better
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should schools start later in the morning to help students perform better?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
I strongly believe that schools should start later in the morning to help students perform better academically.

Firstly, teenagers naturally have different sleep patterns and find it difficult to fall asleep early. Research shows that adolescents need 8-10 hours of sleep, but early school times mean many students arrive tired and unable to concentrate. Starting school at 9 AM instead of 8 AM would allow students to get adequate rest.

Secondly, well-rested students are more attentive in class and achieve better grades. Studies from countries that have implemented later start times show improved academic performance and reduced absenteeism.

However, some argue that later start times could interfere with parents' work schedules and after-school activities. While this is a valid concern, schools could adjust their timetables to finish at reasonable hours.

In conclusion, the benefits of later school start times outweigh the challenges. Schools should prioritize student health and learning by adjusting their schedules accordingly.

t2.sampleB2: This is such a great topic, and I've got to say I'm firmly on the side of later start times! Let's be honest — most teenagers simply can't fall asleep early, no matter how hard they try. It comes down to their body clock, which shifts during adolescence. So when the alarm goes off at six, they drag themselves to school half-asleep and can barely take anything in. How is anyone supposed to perform well like that? From my own experience, the mornings I've had a proper lie-in are the days I feel sharp and ready to learn. A later start would let students catch up on sleep and turn up genuinely alert. Plenty of schools abroad have already made the switch and seen grades go up and absences drop, which really speaks for itself. That said, I do get that it might clash with parents' work schedules or after-school activities — but surely that's something schools and families can work around with a bit of planning. All in all, I reckon the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks. What does everyone else think? Would you be up for a later start?

Men o'quvchilarning akademik ko'rsatkichlari yaxshilanishi uchun maktablar ertalab darslarni kechroq boshlashi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, o'smirlar tabiatan turli xil uyqu tartiblariga ega va erta uxlab qolishlari qiyin. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, o'smirlarga 8-10 soat uyqu kerak, ammo maktabning erta boshlanishi ko'plab o'quvchilarning charchagan holda kelishi va diqqatini jamlay olmasligini anglatadi. Maktabni soat 8 da emas, balki 9 da boshlash o'quvchilarga yetarli darajada dam olish imkonini beradi.

Ikkinchidan, yaxshi dam olgan o'quvchilar darsda ko'proq e'tiborli bo'lishadi va yaxshiroq baholarga erishadilar. Darslarni kechroq boshlashni joriy qilgan mamlakatlarning tadqiqotlari akademik ko'rsatkichlarning yaxshilanishi va davomatning kamayishini ko'rsatadi.

Biroq, ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, darslarning kechroq boshlanishi ota-onalarning ish jadvaliga va darsdan keyingi mashg'ulotlarga xalaqit berishi mumkin. Bu asosli xavotir bo'lsa-da, maktablar o'z jadvallarini moslashtirib, maqbul soatlarda tugatishlari mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktab darslarining kechroq boshlanishining afzalliklari qiyinchiliklardan ustun turadi. Maktablar o'z jadvallarini shunga moslashtirib, o'quvchilar salomatligi va o'rganishiga ustuvor ahamiyat berishlari kerak.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the yoga studio. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear Peaceful Mind Team, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to share my feedback regarding my experience at your yoga studio over the past few weeks. Firstly, I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the quality of instruction provided. The teachers are exceptionally knowledgeable and create a welcoming atmosphere for beginners like myself. The morning sessions at 7 AM are particularly convenient for my schedule. However, I would like to suggest a few improvements. Firstly, it would be helpful to offer more evening classes for people who work during the day. Additionally, I believe that meditation workshops could attract more members interested in mindfulness practices. I look forward to continuing my membership and seeing these improvements implemented. Yours sincerely, Malika Yusupova

t12.sampleB1:
Dear Peaceful Mind Team,

Thank you for your email. I am enjoying the yoga classes at your studio. The instructors are very good and I think the classes are helping me to relax. I especially like the Saturday morning class.

However, I think you could improve some things. For example, it would be good to have more classes on weekday evenings because it's hard for me to come during the day. Also, maybe you could offer some different types of yoga, like hot yoga or yoga for beginners. I think more people would come if you had more variety.

Overall, I am happy with the studio. Thank you for listening to my suggestions.

Sincerely,
Malika Yusupova
t12.sampleB2: Dear Peaceful Mind Team, I am writing to share some feedback on my experience since joining Peaceful Mind Yoga Studio a few weeks ago. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed. The instructors are genuinely knowledgeable and go out of their way to create a welcoming atmosphere, which makes a real difference for beginners like me. That said, I would like to put forward a couple of suggestions. Firstly, it would be enormously helpful to add a few more evening classes, as the current times are tricky for those of us who work full-time. Secondly, I think introducing meditation workshops would appeal to members keen to explore mindfulness in more depth. Thank you for taking my comments on board. I very much look forward to continuing my practice with you. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Men a'zoligimni davom ettirishni va ushbu yaxshilanishlarning amalga oshirilishini ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Malika Yusupova
